paragraphs: HiBoop sells an assessment platform for clinicians who practice measurement-based care. Teams use it to automate screening, read scored results before a session, and track what changes between sessions. The stated buyers are clinics, hospitals and private practices.

The library holds more than fifty validated instruments, scored automatically and tracked session to session. Clients receive a secure link by email, SMS or QR code, with no app download or account required. Scoring triggers real-time notifications for critical items, suicide ideation and clinical deterioration. Rather than writing into the chart directly, the platform exports structured clinical data as PDF reports and CSV.

The company states HIPAA and PIPEDA compliance by design, with encryption, signed business associate agreements, role-based access and annual third-party security audits. It says client data is stored in Canada. Every account is described as including a dedicated implementation specialist who walks the team through setup. A published case study describes the Canadian Addiction Treatment Centres moving off paper-based assessment workflows.
